Explore Loan Services

Loan Services

Loan Services for Every Stage of Enterprise

MASLOC provides microcredit, small loans, hire purchase and wholesale lending — implemented on behalf of the Government of Ghana for start-ups and small businesses.

  • All Services
  • Microcredit
  • Small & Project Loans
  • Hire Purchase
  • Wholesale Lending
  • Eligibility & How to Apply

Loan Service

Microcredit & Group Loans

Microcredit for groups, associations and cooperatives with a common production or operational interest — MASLOC's founding service for community enterprise.

  • Group or cooperative society membership must be between 5 and 25 members.
  • Individual members must be between 18 and 65 years and of sound mind.
  • The group should have a common production or operational interest.
View Microcredit details

Loan Service

Small & Project Loans

Financing for individuals, businesses and joint ventures with an ongoing business or a viable, employment-generating project.

  • Applicant must be 18–65 years and of sound mind.
  • Must have an ongoing business venture or project.
  • Must have sound knowledge and considerable experience in the business or project.
View Small & Project Loans details

Loan Service

Vehicle & Equipment Hire Purchase

A hire purchase scheme enabling drivers and working entrepreneurs to own the vehicles and equipment central to their livelihoods.

  • Applicant must be 18–65 years and of sound mind.
  • Must have an ongoing business venture or project.
  • Must have sound knowledge and considerable experience in the venture.
View Hire Purchase details

Loan Service

Wholesale Lending & Microfinance Support

Wholesale lending to microfinance institutions for on-lending to small businesses, alongside institutional support for the microfinance sub-sector.

  • Facilities are directed to microfinance institutions for on-lending to small businesses.
  • Terms, criteria and participating-institution requirements are set by MASLOC and available directly from the institution.
  • Microfinance institutions should enquire at the Accra Head Office for current wholesale arrangements.
View Wholesale Lending details

Supporting Services

Business Training & Advisory Services

Beyond financing, MASLOC delivers business training and advisory services to help entrepreneurs manage their operations — part of its mandate for enterprise development.

See training & other initiatives
